summary: Verified iter322 extension of x-client-recipients Taller-routing pattern to two additional actions: (1) POST /api/quotes/{id}/repair-complete and (2) POST /api/quotes/{id}/custom-action/{action_id} (pago_validado_rep). Backend pytest 5/5 pass; frontend Quotes page smoke test passes with no console/JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: quote_actions.py repair_complete (L1129,L1166,L1187,L1218-1222): x-client-recipients parsed and forwarded to _engine_or_legacy(client_recipients_override=...) AND to legacy path (client_email=[0], extras→cc). Symmetric with approve_quote. OK.

quote_action_customization.py dispatch_custom_action (L248,L355-358): header parsed inline and passed to try_dispatch(client_recipients_override=...). Consistent scope: only client_field rows are overridden by the engine (notification_engine.py L481-485). OK.

Minor DRY: three call-sites now duplicate the same [e.strip() for e in (client_recipients or '').split(',') if e.strip() and '@' in e.strip()] parsing. Consider a helper _parse_client_recipients_header() in a shared util to avoid drift.

Frontend Quotes.jsx: handleRepairComplete (async, resolveTallerForCustom, A/B/C branches) + _openRepairCompleteModal injecting emailHeaders — page renders without regressions in smoke run; grid loads 132 rows, no console errors, no white screen.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily overwrote db.clients.contacts for 3 clients during pytest scenarios and reset quote_status back to Aprobada after repair-complete tests. All originals restored via try/finally. No permanent DB mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter322_repair_taller_recipient.py (5 tests). Covers: repair-complete Scenario A (header wins → Reparada + logs), Scenario C (no header → primary in logs), custom-action pago_validado_rep baseline (no header), with-header (200 + best-effort override check when client_field row is dispatched), and repair-complete header acceptance when quote is in wrong state (must return 400, not 5xx). Companion to iter321 (approve). Frontend Scenario A/B/C UI flow (modal 'Personalizar Comunicación' → 'Seleccionar Destinatarios' if 2+ taller → RepairCompleteModal / ejecuta custom action con headers) was not exercised end-to-end because it requires a repair quote in 'Aprobada' with a client having 2+ taller contacts to trigger scenario B; header wiring is validated at backend level (parity with approve). The frontend RepairCompleteModal.jsx already passes emailHeaders (verified by code review of L127-141), and executeCustomAction adds x-client-recipients via emailHeaders — consistent with approve pattern already E2E-tested in iter321.
rca of the issue: N/A — parity feature verified. Header x-client-recipients is now honored uniformly across approve, repair-complete and custom-action endpoints; override propagates through _engine_or_legacy → notification_engine.try_dispatch (ctx.client_recipients_override → client_field rows) and legacy is_repair path. Non-regression confirmed (no header → primary contact used).
